name: discover_tools
title: Discover Pressable Tools
description:
List the Pressable operations you can perform. Returns each operation's name,
title, a one-line summary, and category — but not its full input schema (use
describe_tool for that). Use this first to find the operation you need, then
describe_tool to learn its parameters, then execute_tool to run it.

Optionally pass `query` to filter operations by a case-insensitive substring
match against name, title, and summary (e.g. "backup", "dns", "plugin").

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter operations by name, title, or summary.

name: describe_tool
title: Describe a Pressable Tool
description:
Return the full definition of one Pressable operation: its title, description,
input schema (parameters, types, and which are required), and behavior
annotations. Call discover_tools first to find the operation name, then pass it
here to learn exactly how to call it with execute_tool.

tool_name.description: The exact operation name from discover_tools (e.g. "get_site_status").

name: execute_tool
title: Execute a Pressable Tool
description:
Run a Pressable operation by name with the given parameters. Call discover_tools
to find the operation and describe_tool to learn its input schema first, then pass
the operation name and a parameters object here. Authorization, input validation,
and behavior are identical to calling the operation directly.

tool_name.description: The exact operation name from discover_tools (e.g. "get_site_status").

parameters.description: The operation's parameters, matching its input schema from describe_tool.
